errors.evidence: The line for the EU (ЕС) clearly starts at 5% in the year 2000, not 4%.
The line for the USA (САЩ) starts at approximately 13% in the year 2000, making the stated value of 12% a significant underestimation.

errors.text_span: се покачва постепенно до около 15% през 2018 година
errors.evidence: The line for the OECD (ОИСР) is visibly above the 15% mark in 2018, closer to 16%. Stating it is 'около 15%' (around 15%) is an underestimation.

The line for Bulgaria (България) reaches approximately 6.5% in 2018. The stated value of 7% is an overestimation for that specific year, although the line does approach 7% at its very end point around 2019.
